values.units: points per week above replacement, aged by the market curve
values.note: Players priced from production under this league’s own scoring against its own replacement level, aged by a curve fitted to real dynasty trades. Team totals are recomputed weekly from live rosters. A player at or below replacement is carried at zero: he costs his manager nothing, because nobody has to start him.

lead.headline: The Crew Paid The Same Price Twice, Then Won By 1.16
lead.dek: Charles Robinson gave up a 2027 first and two 2027 seconds for Patrick Mahomes on Saturday, which the valuation desk prices at a dead heat. Two days later he gave up a 2027 first and two 2027 seconds for Parker Washington, which it prices at 39 per cent against him. lead.headline: Ninety-Four Per Cent Efficient, And It Cost Him A Week Off In December
lead.dek: Blame spanos left 7.00 points on his bench, the tidiest ten anybody but one man put on the field, and lost by 14.70 — and his first-round-bye probability fell from 22.8% to 3.3%. Cheddar Bobs is 5-0 and now the championship favourite. And in seven days not one player in this league changed hands.
